AI Engineer with 8 years of experience building and deploying machine learning solutions across industrial and enterprise environments. Specialized in developing LLM applications, RAG systems, and fine-tuning language models for automated workflows. Proven track record of reducing operational inefficiencies through AI implementation - from industrial diagnostic systems to customer onboarding platforms. Currently architecting scalable AI infrastructure including LLM, TTS, STT pipelines on GPU clusters. Driven by curiosity and passion for leveraging AI to solve complex business challenges across diverse domains.
Key Achievements
H
Downtime Reduction Reduced equipment downtime by 900+ hours across 50+ machine types with 78% F1 score accuracy.
